newsitem.title: USA: CBOE names CME's Brodsky chairman, CEO - sources.
newsitem.headline: CBOE names CME's Brodsky chairman, CEO - sources.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange named William Brodsky as its chairman and chief executive, industry sources said Wednesday.
Brodsky is currently president and chief executive officer of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
He will replace outgoing CBOE chairman and chief executive Alger "Duke" Chapman.
The CBOE's board of directors, meeting in New York, voted after a recommendation from the exchange's succession committee, the sources said.
CBOE and CME officials were not available for comment.
Chapman is scheduled to retire in 1997.
Brodsky and CBOE vice chairman William Floersch were the top two contenders for the post, the sources said.
